statements.status_notes: CVE-2023-45924 is a segmentation violation in glXGetDrawableScreen() in libglxproto.c, requiring a GLX client connected to an attacker-controlled X server. This image contains no X server: `command -v Xvfb` and `command -v Xorg` find nothing in either variant, and chromium runs headless as a Selenium Grid node without ever opening an X display, so the GLX client path has no server to receive malicious replies from. The CVE is disputed upstream (NVD note: no common situation requires uninterrupted operation against an attacker-controlled server) and Debian marks it unimportant.
